The relationship between volume and hypertrophy is hypothesized to follow an inverted-U curve, whereby muscle accretion peaks at a given volume load and, beyond this point, further increases in volume can actually impair muscular gains () (99). It is important to note that the threshold for volume-related hypertrophic benefits varies based on genetics (see chapter 7); lifestyle-related factors such as nutritional status, daily stress levels, and sleep patterns also play a role in individual responses.
